items.title: Mandel Johnny — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I wasn’t able to work so I wrote for the band, that’s when I wrote, “Not Really the Blues,”

ctx.x: Because Al Cohn left Buddy Rich when I was with him in ‘47 to go with Woody and the Second Herd had already started, which I think was really one of the best bands I've ever heard play at any given time. In fact it came out to California to play the Empire room while I was getting my card, and I wasn’t able to work so I wrote for the band, that’s when I wrote, “Not Really the Blues,” and a bunch of those things.
Was that the only one that was recorded?
